title: HELIX Terminology: Delivery Mode
description: Standard instructional delivery modes for course sections and programs.

codes.definition: Traditional face-to-face instruction in a physical classroom
Online instruction with scheduled real-time meetings (via Zoom, Teams, etc.)
Online instruction with no scheduled meeting times. Students access materials on their own schedule.
Mix of in-person and online components, with reduced in-person seat time
Students choose per-session whether to attend in person or online synchronously
Progress based on demonstrated mastery rather than seat time
Self-paced study via mailed or digital materials with limited instructor interaction
Supervised hands-on experience in a clinical, field, or professional setting
Work-integrated learning in a professional setting
